description: A professional dermatologist-inspired skincare or haircare routine designed to protect and enhance the health of color-treated hair.
frequency: Daily for morning and night steps, weekly for specific treatments
estimated_time: 15-20 minutes daily, additional time for deep conditioning treatments

morning_steps.action: Apply a lightweight moisturizing leave-in conditioner or silk protein spray.
morning_steps.purpose: To hydrate and protect hair from environmental stressors while styling in the morning.

night_steps.action: Gently massage a nourishing leave-in conditioner or deep treatment into your hair and scalp.
night_steps.purpose: To repair and moisturize the hair overnight, preventing dryness and damage.

weekly_steps.action: Apply a deep conditioning mask or do a hot oil treatment to deeply nourish and repair the hair.

do: Use gentle, sulfate-free shampoos and conditioners.
Regularly use heat protectants before styling with heat tools.
Stay hydrated by drinking plenty of water daily.
dont: Avoid over-washing your hair as it can strip natural oils.
Minimize the use of heat styling tools to prevent damage.
Do not apply heavy styling products that may weigh down and damage your hair.
common_mistakes: Overwashing or using harsh chemicals that can strip color from hair.
Failing to protect hair from environmental stressors, leading to further damage.

expected_results.2_weeks: Significantly improved hair hydration, reduced frizz and flyaways.
expected_results.1_month: Noticeable increase in hair strength and elasticity, with a softer texture.
expected_results.3_months: Stabilized hair color, with vibrant hues and reduced fading.

expert_tips: Always perform a patch test before introducing new products to your routine.
Consider consulting a dermatologist or trichologist for personalized recommendations based on specific hair concerns.
